text: Cross serves as a Marshal field agent on a Ranger crew within the galactic_union faction (org_union_marshals).

Frontier Enforcement Escalation Study (sim capture): maintained situational oversight; documented enemy armor/weapons via helmet-mounted 3D imaging, transmitted to Roake; fired a Viper from the hip during surprise contact with an elite vanguard unit; called for ordnance under comms jamming; accessed the station data core before disengagement.
Operates in doctrinal pair with Vorn as a single tactical unit; crew logistics and resupply run through Roake aboard the Ranger gunboat.
Standard Marshal kit: Spatha Moderna (spade), MR-6 heavy service revolver (iron), MFR-9 Viper rifle, deployable wrist shield.
